summary: Figure 6 reports 404 WT mediobasal hypothalamic genes for cagrilintide versus vehicle (96 up, 308 down) and labels the groups n = 6. The registered analysis includes seven vehicle and eight treated ARC libraries and has zero genes at BH adjusted P < 0.05. The final sample IDs, Figure 6 calling rule and gene-level author results remain unresolved.

manualReview.summary: Figure 6 reports 404 WT MBH genes. Its cohort and calling rule require author clarification.
manualReview.note: Study 3 assigned eight male mice per arm and specified daily cagrilintide at 3 nmol/kg for 21 days. The GEO series gives the same dose, while the eight registered treated GSMs say 0.3 nmol/kg. The authors describe bilateral mediobasal hypothalamic (MBH) punches including ARC and VMN. GEO labels these libraries ARC. Of 138 brain samples, 117 qualified for sequencing. GEO lists 116 libraries across the study. CountQC removed two ARC samples across groups, with their identities unspecified. Figure 6 prints n = 6 per group and shows 404 WT cagrilintide DEGs relative to WT vehicle in MBH (96 up, 308 down). The Results and GEO summary restrict the WT zero-DEG finding to DVC and LPBN. The Discussion makes a broader statement about the absence of a treatment effect without specifying how it relates to the MBH bars. The registered limma fit uses all seven WT vehicle and eight WT cagrilintide ARC deposits. The input kallisto files match the registered checksums. On log2(gene-summed TPM + 1), 28,705 symbols were published, with zero at BH adjusted P < 0.05 and 2,985 at raw P < 0.05 (2,146 up, 839 down). Minimum published adjusted P was 0.0643336618892822. The authors used the SUSHI DESeq2App. The sources examined provide no Figure 6 sample manifest, gene identifiers, per-gene statistics or exact DEG rule. Gene-level agreement and author reference coverage remain unassessed.
reviewFlags: If the published n = 6 applied to both WT MBH arms and both came from the deposits, one vehicle and two treated libraries would fall outside the figure. CountQC reported two ARC removals across all arms and gave no IDs. The final per-arm membership is unknown.
The 404 calls lack a Figure 6 statistical rule and gene identifiers. The general significance statement and Figure 7 module-analysis criteria cannot establish which tests counted toward the bars.
The publisher appendix matches the Europe PMC ZIP member and the PMC Open Access copy byte for byte. The same-named BioStudies file contains unrelated respiratory-patient tables.

The indexed February 2025 preprint abstract describes no significant treatment effect across any region in WT and KO mice. The published Figure 6 gives the region- and contrast-specific count. The broader prose supplies no gene-level comparison.

verificationReview.reason: The published WT cagrilintide-versus-vehicle MBH bars show 404 DEGs. The caption reports n = 6 per group. Explorer fits seven vehicle and eight treated ARC libraries and returns zero BH discoveries. The publication does not identify the retained WT libraries or the Figure 6 calling rule. The reported totals alone cannot establish gene-level agreement.
